title: Agent Tool Requested Event
description: Emitted before an agent invokes a tool. Pairs with agent.tool.invoked: the request fires from the PreToolUse hook (intent), the invocation fires from the PostToolUse hook (result). Same session_id correlates them. Consumers use the pairing to detect tools that requested but never completed (cancellation, timeout, agent crash).

type.description: Locked event type for this schema.

session_id.description: Identifier of the session that issued the request. Matches session_id from the corresponding agent.session.started event.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool the agent intends to invoke. Producer-defined; consumers should treat unknown names as opaque rather than enum-restricted.

tool_input.description: Raw tool-specific input as the agent prepared it. Schema is per-tool and intentionally not constrained here. Producers may redact or truncate at their discretion.

working_directory.description: Absolute path the agent was operating in when the request was made.

git_branch.description: Git branch at request time. Empty string when not in a git repo.

turn_number.description: 1-based turn counter within the session at the time of the request.
